## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 标准 8 区过滤（所有引用均使用）
WHERE grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')

-- 日期范围过滤
WHERE grass_date >= '2023-02-23'
  AND grass_date <= '2023-03-02'

-- 指定实验
WHERE experiment_id = 6293

-- 实验版本过滤（用于排除缓存影响，仅部分分析使用）
WHERE exp_version >= 79640
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

该表通常在 CTE 中独立查询（SELECT DISTINCT 提取实验用户列表），然后与 `abtest.abtest_mart_dws_assignment_agg_1d` UNION 以补全 assignment 缺失：

```sql
ab_list1 as (
    SELECT DISTINCT grass_date, grass_region, experiment_id, group_id, user_id
    FROM traffic.shopee_traffic_dws_abtest_hit_log_di__reg_live
    WHERE ...
),
ab_list2 as (
    SELECT DISTINCT local_date as grass_date, grass_region, experiment_id, group_id, user_id
    FROM abtest.abtest_mart_dws_assignment_agg_1d
    WHERE ...
),
ab_list as (
    SELECT * FROM ab_list1
    UNION
    SELECT * FROM ab_list2
)
```

下游通过 `user_id`, `grass_date`, `grass_region` 与效果表 JOIN：

```sql
LEFT JOIN ads_perf
ON ab_list.grass_date = ads_perf.grass_date
   AND ab_list.grass_region = ads_perf.grass_region
   AND ab_list.user_id = ads_perf.user_id
```

常见下游 JOIN 表：`mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live`, `mkplpaidads_data.ads_tracking`

## Common Aggregations

该表本身不做聚合，只做 SELECT DISTINCT 提取用户列表。下游聚合模式：

```sql
SELECT experiment_id, grass_region, group_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS num_users,
       SUM(ads_imp) AS ads_imp,
       SUM(ads_clicks) AS ads_clicks,
       SUM(ads_rev_usd) AS ads_rev_usd
FROM merged
GROUP BY experiment_id, grass_region, group_id
```

实验指标计算：

```sql
SUM(ads_clicks) / SUM(ads_imp) AS ctr
SUM(ads_rev_usd) / SUM(ads_clicks) AS cpc
```
